contract.baseline: Fixed-configuration authoritative generic NVIDIA Triton, not B200-exclusive tuning
contract.input_generation: CPU fp32 generator seed20261020+shape_index, then CPU cast to true requested input dtype
contract.timed_scope: Only selected upstream Triton leaf; all allocations, CPU references, metadata and layout preparation excluded
contract.source_transform: Strip tuning/heuristic wrappers by selecting their existing JITFunction; original kernel body unchanged
contract.fp8_policy: True float8 input and output. Dot operators use native float8 tl.dot with fp32 accumulator; no harness fp16 substitution. Convolution computes fp32 from float8 storage; cache only copies storage.
contract.precision_validation: FP32 IEEE tl.dot allow_tf32=False explicit at every selected dot; independent CPU fp64 reference. FP32 matrix tolerance rtol2e-5/atol1e-4 prespecified for K<=512, not changed in response to observations.
contract.formula: Scatter K,V tokens to preassigned physical paged-cache slots; remaining slots unchanged
contract.entrypoint: flag_gems.fused.reshape_and_cache_flash.reshape_and_cache_flash_kernel direct Triton leaf, avoids optional C extension
contract.layout: B200 physical cache[blocks,page,heads,D], A5 [blocks,heads,page,D]; equivalent logical cache but physical layout differs
contract.metadata: Unique shuffled slots from CPU seed; conversion of page metadata excluded from timed scope; metadata read bytes counted
contract.state: Caches initialized once to zero outside timing; repeated idempotent writes of identical K/V; whole caches checked against reference
contract.fp8_scope: Exact float8 storage copy only, no scale/quantization and no FP8 arithmetic claim. Source TODO refers to dtype conversion, not asserted as supported until actual direct-leaf smoke.
